parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=8! val_bpb 0.819325 is my new best. It seems increasing depth from 6 to 8 provides significant capacity gains. Next, I will test reducing the learning rate to 0.02 to see if more stable, smaller steps can further refine the performance of this deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 on DEPTH=8 to see if slower convergence leads to better local minima.
